lines.speaker: granny_mi
lines.en: The east road is shut. The hive has gone mad.

lines.speaker: granny_mi
lines.en: No one can take {C115} to the next land. Something is wrong with the Queen.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: We'll walk the hive road and look.

lines.speaker: granny_mi
lines.en: Ask Yezi if you reach the hive. Go carefully.

lines.speaker: granny_mi
lines.en: The Bell Road stays closed until the hive is calm.
